== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster removes the draw alternative on a non-battleground drain. It puts the Effect download in the deploy phase and separately retains the once-per-turn Juri Juice cancellation. The original phrases the download and Juri Juice actions as alternatives.
